name: AMBANK
recent: AMMB 近期完成以 RM331 million 向 AMFIRST REIT 收购 Menara AmBank 的交易，并已于 2026 年 10 月 23 日结清余款。EPF 持续减持，持股降至 17.2%。最新季度营收环比增长 3.5%，净利环比基本持平。
notable: AMMB 以 RM331 million 向 AMFIRST REIT 收购 Menara AmBank，交易已于 2026 年 10 月 23 日完成。
EPF 于 2026 年 10 月 31 日进一步减持 780 万股后，持股比例降至 17.2%。
CG (L) Foundation 于 2026 年 10 月 29 日披露成为大股东（Notice of Interest Sub. S-hldr）。
risks: EPF 在 10 月至 11 月期间连续多日申报持股变动，整体呈减持趋势。
2026 年 11 月 4 日有一则关于清盘 / 接管人 / 限制令 / 特别管理人的公告。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 MYR 1,312.96 million，环比增长 3.5%，同比增长 3.3%；净利为 MYR 520.23 million，环比微降 0.1%，同比增长 0.8%；净利率为 39.6%，低于上一季度的 41.0%。

recent_en: AMMB recently completed the RM331 million acquisition of Menara AmBank from AMFIRST REIT, settling the balance on 23 October 2026. EPF continued to reduce its stake to 17.2%. Latest quarter revenue rose 3.5% QoQ while net profit was broadly flat QoQ.
notable_en: AMMB acquired Menara AmBank from AMFIRST REIT for RM331 million, completed on 23 October 2026.
EPF further disposed 7.8 million shares, reducing its stake to 17.2% as of 31 October 2026.
CG (L) Foundation disclosed on 29 October 2026 that it became a substantial shareholder.
risks_en: EPF filed multiple consecutive changes in its shareholding from October to November, with an overall reducing trend.
A winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator announcement was made on 4 November 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 1,312.96 million, up 3.5% QoQ and 3.3% YoY; net profit was MYR 520.23 million, down 0.1% QoQ and up 0.8% YoY; net margin was 39.6%, lower than 41.0% in the previous quarter.
